basic_info.main_problem: I believe I will end up dying alone because of introversion; this belief causes loneliness and Fear of the future, pushing me to increasingly Avoids socializing.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I think some practical steps would help me start feeling less lonely and more in control of my future.'
growth_experiences: Persistent loneliness and Fear of the future began in adolescence, especially evident during life transitions; with age, the tendency to Avoids socializing has grown, and professional help has not yet been actively sought.
Limited contact with extended family, long-term Living alone, a Weak support system in real life, mainly relying on a few online friends to share interests.
Became a Comic artist through Self-study, with sustained dedication and self-management ability, receiving positive feedback from others as 'considerate and creative.'

core_beliefs: I am destined to die alone
As an introvert, it is hard for me to build intimate relationships

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot possibly have such relationships; I will always be alone, ending up dying alone

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not naturally outgoing in social settings, it means I am not suited for intimate relationships

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too introverted, cannot possibly have intimate relationships

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am often Being alone, others will not want to be with me

core_conflict.fear: Fear of Being rejected, being negated, and ending up alone for life

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on setting concrete social attempt goals or behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling pushed to expose my inadequacies, worrying failure will confirm 'I am not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Repeatedly emphasizing 'I am just introverted' in a gentle but firm tone, raising many practical difficulties to postpone or downplay action commitments.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing sensitive topics such as being liked by others and building intimate relationships
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Anticipation others will not accept me, internalizing potential rejection as my own flaw
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lowering volume, with self-blaming expressions (e.g., 'it is all my fault'), restrained tone, avoiding eye contact, quickly ending the topic.

manifestations: Repeatedly worrying about never having an intimate relationship in life, believing I will 'die alone'
Experiencing stronger loneliness and Fear when seeing others' relationships or Social gatherings

outcomes: Persistent loneliness and Fear of the future
Decreased motivation, reduced engagement in hobbies and self-care

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Labeling myself with 'I am too introverted' 'I am not good enough'
Especially cautious on topics involving intimacy and socializing; tends to lower self-expectations

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Assuming without evidence that others 'will not want to be with me'
Externally attributes potential feelings of rejection to others' wishes

exception_events.target_problem: When seeing others dating or in social scenes, Lin Hai Li typically feels loneliness and Fear of the future, and thus avoids further interaction.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When discussing shared interests with a few online friends, she did not avoid as usual, but kept natural interaction and sharing, gaining some sense of connection.
exception_events.reason: Different situation: a small circle based on shared interests, where the pace and distance of online communication lowered social pressure; different approach: focusing on the interests themselves rather than self-evaluation.
